name: Community — MOSS-Image Finetunes
author: toya_san / catlover1937 / lodestones (pack: michaeldune)
description: Three MOSS-Image finetunes, each tested side by side against the MOSS-Image pack. Sam_MOSS Turbo (Civitai): natural-looking pictures in 8 steps, about 12 seconds on a 12 GB card. Moody Moss Mix (Civitai): deeper contrast and richer colour, 25 steps, about 27 seconds. Kromoss Turbo (lodestones, since 1.1.0): a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base with an 8-step LoRA, about 4 seconds, more variety and more literal layouts, but less reliable small lettering. Put every word you want on the picture in quotes. They share the MOSS-Image text encoder and autoencoder, so each card adds only its own 5-7 GB if you already have the MOSS-Image pack. Like that pack, it needs a SimpliGen engine with MOSS-Image support, which today means the beta engine (Settings > Updates > beta).

presets.name: Sam_MOSS Turbo
presets.description: toya_san's Sam_MOSS Turbo v2, a MOSS-Image finetune with the speed built in: 8 steps, about 12 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card, no speed LoRA. Its skin and light look natural rather than retouched, and it keeps the light and mood you ask for, so it suits portraits and photo-style prompts better than MOSS-Image Fast. Lettering is MOSS-good: put every word you want in quotes. It can still drop a word from a small label now and then, so check signs and buttons.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3008366 (Sam_MOSS by toya_san), version 3416093 'Turbo v2.0', file samMOSS_turboV20.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit, Rent, Sell, SellMerge. Author settings: er_sde / simple, 8 steps, CFG 1. Measured ~12 s per picture across changing prompts. Against our cards: the most natural skin of the fast models tested, kept the dawn light in the fisherman test; one slip on 9 prompts ('17 Pro' without 'iPhone' on a small card). Rejected in the same test: Moss Image Turbo and Artius Moss (one family, retouched skin, weaker prompt following), Mosaic (paid access). Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts (six posters, three photos), seed 11.

presets.name: Moody Moss Mix
presets.tagline: MOSS-Image with deeper contrast and richer colour
presets.description: catlover1937's Moody Moss Mix, a MOSS-Image finetune with more contrast and saturation than the base model: darker shadows, richer colour, painterly when you ask for illustration. Lettering stays exact: put every word you want in quotes. 25 steps at CFG 3, about 27 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. Pick it for a punchier look; for a neutral one, use MOSS-Image.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3007871 (Moody Moss Mix by catlover1937), version 3414956 'V1.0 25 STEPS CFG3', file moodyMossMixFreeDownload_v1025STEPSCFG3_3307706.safetensors (int8, 4.74 GB, sha256 pinned). Licence flags on Civitai: RentCivit only (no selling of pictures listed). The version name gives 25 steps / CFG 3; no sampler is given, er_sde / simple is the MOSS-Image default. presets.name: Kromoss Turbo
presets.tagline: Photographic MOSS in 8 steps, with more variety per seed
presets.description: lodestones' Kromoss, a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base on 704,000 pictures, with its own 8-step speed LoRA: about 4 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. It follows layout and composition directions more literally than MOSS-Image, gives much more variety between seeds, and its photos look natural rather than retouched; posters can come out looking like real printed paper. Lettering: big headlines in quotes come out right, but small signs and thin fonts can lose or garble a word, so for text that must be exact use MOSS-Image. Ask for a "woman" or "man" and give an age: with "girl" it draws teenagers, and people can look younger than with MOSS-Image even then.

requirements.notes: lodestones/Kromoss pinned to commit 7f9bb7b0 (2026-10-20, update 11000 EMA, Apache-2.0): kromoss_int8_convrot.safetensors (ConvRot W8A8 like Comfy-Org's SFT int8, 5.41 GB) and 8-steps-dmd2-lora (DMD then DMD2's GAN stage, distilled from MOSS-Image-Base, rank 128, 1.19 GB, saved as kromoss_8step_dmd2_lora.safetensors), both sha256 pinned. Author settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple, no negative branch. TESTED 2026-10-20 engine-direct on nine prompts at seed 11 and four prompts at seeds 7, 11 and 42 against both MOSS-Image cards (F:/Claude-Work/kromoss-20261020): ~4 s per picture; composition followed the prompt 6/6 where the MOSS cards did about half; a 1970s poster's shop sign lost or garbled a word on 3 of 6 renders (MOSS cards 5/6 right); 'photo of a girl' drew teenagers, 'woman' gave adults on 2 of 3 seeds. The author's small FLUX.2 decoder was not used; the shared Flux 2 VAE works. Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts (six posters, three photos), seed 11.
